name: CardProduct
description: A credit card product offered by the bank. Defines the commercial terms: APR, rewards type, annual fee, and eligibility criteria. Owned by SVC-003. Multiple products may be active simultaneously. CardProduct is a reference/catalogue entity — not customer-specific.

fields.name: name
fields.validation_rule: Required. Max 100 characters. Must be unique across active products.

fields.name: base_apr
fields.validation_rule: Required. APR as percentage (e.g. 24.9). Calculated per CCA 1974 Schedule 5. Representative APR per CONC 3.5.3.
fields.transparency_note: Representative APR must be disclosed prominently in all marketing and at application stage (CONC 3.5.3).

fields.name: rewards_type
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: none | cashback | points | airmiles.

fields.name: annual_fee
fields.validation_rule: Required. GBP. 0.00 for no-fee products. Must be disclosed at application stage.

fields.name: eligibility_criteria
fields.validation_rule: Required. JSON: min_age (integer, default 18), min_income_gbp (decimal), uk_resident_required (boolean), existing_customer_required (boolean), max_existing_cards (integer or null).

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: active | withdrawn. Soft-withdrawn only — no deletion.

relationships.description: One CardProduct may be referenced by many CreditCardApplications.

design_decisions.decision: eligibility_criteria stored as a JSON object on the entity rather than a separate entity.
design_decisions.rationale: Criteria are product-specific and consulted in bulk at PH-023. JSON column avoids a join at the high-frequency pre-eligibility check path.
